chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Jameel ibn Salih, who said:
Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said: 'Beware of the consequences of the slips (of the tongues)'.
ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Sadiq mean by 'consequences of slips' in the context of Taqiyya?
ai.summary: In the context of Taqiyya, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) warns that minor slips, particularly of the tongue, can precipitate significant consequences or lead to greater errors. This hadith underscores the necessity of vigilance in speech to maintain doctrinal integrity and avoid unintended exposure during periods of concealment. It highlights how small linguistic missteps can unravel the careful balance required in Shia practice under pressure.

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Jameel Bin Salih who said,
‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Beware of the consequences of the slips (of the tongues)’.
en.sarwar: 22. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Jamil ibn Salih who has said the following:
“Abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) has said, ‘Stay away from the consequences of slip and mistake (disregarding al-Taqiyyah’).’"’
